entities.name: Khmelnytsky Uprising
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Khmelnytsky Uprising, a transformative movement in Poland (1648–1700). Emerged from Union of Lublin & Golden Liberty and Warsaw Confederation. Catalyzed Jan III and Jan III Sobieski's relief of the Siege of Vienna.
